text: Chiara's driving test is on Friday at 9:40. She's failed it twice already and is really nervous this time, mostly about parallel parking. Her dad has been taking her out every evening this week to practise in the Tesco car park, which she says is making it worse. Text her good luck Thursday night, and maybe offer to take her out for a drive on Wednesday instead.
Nikhil mentioned his sister Deepa has her grade 8 piano exam on May 14. He's driving her up to Leeds for it.
Lunch with Sara. Her birthday is June 3rd and she keeps talking about getting into pottery. A taster class voucher would go down well.
Bridget's results day is next Thursday. Her mum is more stressed about it than she is, apparently.
Fern got into the youth orchestra! Audition was last Saturday and they told her this morning. Must send her a card.
Samir and Ruby are throwing a joint thirtieth on 7/19 at their place. Bring something for the barbecue.

Bao passed his theory test this morning, first attempt. Practical is booked for 8/2. He's having lessons with his uncle on Saturdays and with an instructor on Tuesdays. His girlfriend Lola says he's surprisingly calm about it all. I should send him a congrats text later and ask how the lessons are going.
Owen's dad is in hospital for a hip replacement tomorrow. Owen is going to stay with his mum for the week.
Need to pick up the dry cleaning and renew the car insurance before Monday.

Ayo's audition for the drama school is in a fortnight. She's been rehearsing a monologue from Medea every evening and says she still can't get through it without crying. Her flatmate Zofia has been reading the other parts for her. If she gets in, she'd move to London in September, which her mum is not keen on at all.

Called Nina. Her son Lachlan sits his GCSE maths resit next Tuesday, and he's barely sleeping. She asked if I'd have a word with him, since I tutored him last year. I said I'd ring him this weekend. Also, her husband Pedro has started a new job at the council, which is why she sounded so tired.

Gabriel loves anything to do with Formula 1. Birthday is September 9, so start thinking. He mentioned that Silverstone does driving experience days, though they're pricey. Maybe split it with Irina and Stefan? He also said he'd like a decent signed photo of Senna for the study, if a group present doesn't work out.
Irina's bar exam results came out yesterday and she passed. Remind me to take her out for a drink to celebrate.
Lola's dog Biscuit had surgery on his paw on Tuesday. He's home now but wearing the cone.
Petra has her citizenship test on March 21. She's been studying the handbook on the train.
Deepa said her brother Nikhil is moving to Bristol at the end of the month. Their parents aren't thrilled.

Oliver's wedding has been called off. Stefan told me after football. Oliver and his fiancée split up a couple of weeks ago, and he's staying at Stefan's until he finds somewhere. Should check in with him next week, gently.
Agnieszka Nowak, Aga to everyone, has her viva on Wednesday the 12th. Four years of work riding on it. Send her a good luck message the night before.
Ilse and Tobi are expecting their second in February. Tobi says their daughter keeps asking if it'll be a sister.
Zofia is obsessed with Studio Ghibli at the moment. Could get her the Totoro art book for her birthday on April 2nd.

Reza's mum turns seventy on Sunday. He's organising a surprise dinner at the Italian place near the station and is worried his aunts won't keep quiet. His brother Ignacio is flying in from Madrid on Saturday morning. I'm bringing the cake. Reza says she'd love a framed photo of the whole family, so I might help him with that.
Marcus failed his driving test again yesterday, minor faults on the roundabout. He's gutted. I should give him a call tonight.

Delroy is coeliac, so no beer for his birthday. He's into whisky instead, especially the smoky Islay ones. Marcus said Delroy has been dropping hints about a tasting set from that shop on the high street. His birthday is next Friday, so I need to order it by Tuesday at the latest.
Ignacio's kids both have swimming gala on Saturday. Ignacio is coaching the younger one's relay team.
Book the dentist and sort out the passport renewal this week.
Aurelio has his cello audition with the city symphony on June 17th. He's been practising six hours a day. His partner Hugo says he hasn't eaten a proper dinner in a week.
Chiara mentioned her nephew starts at uni next month, studying architecture in Glasgow.
Text Bridget on Friday to see how her nursing exams went.
Sara's partner Owen just got promoted to head of science. He starts the new role after half term.
Nikhil's daughter has her 11+ on September 14. He's trying to stay calm about it but clearly isn't.
Fern says Samir is training for the Berlin marathon in late September. He runs before work every day now.
Quick note: Ruby's niece Bao is taking her violin exam in a fortnight, and Ruby wants us all to come to the recital the week after.
Don't forget Owen's birthday on Thursday. He mentioned wanting a new pair of trail running shoes, size 10.
Ayo told me her grandad passed away last weekend. The funeral is on the 28th in Lagos and she's flying out on Monday. Must get a sympathy card in the post before she goes.
Nina's twins have their first ballet show next Saturday afternoon. I've already said I'll go.
Pedro is a massive Arsenal fan and collects old matchday programmes.
Lachlan got his A level results this morning: an A and two Bs. He's into Edinburgh for engineering! His mum Nina was in tears on the phone.
Gabriel's sister Irina has her PhD graduation on July 8th. Gabriel is flying back from Lisbon for it.
Petra says Lola has been struggling with the new job and isn't sleeping. Maybe invite Lola round for dinner this weekend.
Oliver's son Stefan has his first piano recital tomorrow evening. Oliver is more nervous than Stefan is, which is sweet.
Agnieszka and her husband are celebrating their tenth anniversary in Rome over the long weekend. They fly out Thursday.

Long chat with Ilse after yoga. Her mum has just been diagnosed with early dementia, and Ilse is going down to Exeter every other weekend now. Her brother Hugo is meant to be helping but has barely shown up. She's thinking about going part time from January. She seemed exhausted but said talking helped. I should ring her next week and maybe drop off some food on Sunday.
Tobi's driving test was cancelled because of the snow. The new date is 12/9.
Zofia is vegan and hates mushrooms, worth remembering for the dinner party.
Reza and his wife have a scan on Monday. Finding out if it's a boy or a girl.
Ask Marcus how his mum's knee operation went on Tuesday.

Delroy's daughter Ruby has her grade 5 flute exam on Wednesday, then her school play on Friday, and her birthday the Sunday after. Busy week for them. Remember to get Ruby a present before Sunday, something craft-related since she loves making things.
Ignacio Rossi from work has his citizenship ceremony on November 4. He's invited a few of us.
Aurelio didn't get the orchestra job in the end. He's disappointed but says he'll audition again in the spring.
Need to get Hugo a card for his fortieth on the 23rd, and chip in for the group present.
Chiara's boyfriend Nikhil has proposed! They're thinking a summer wedding next year.
Bridget's little brother Owen is sitting his black belt grading on Saturday. She's going to film it for their gran.

Fern's cat Pickle went missing on Sunday night. Still no sign of him. She's put posters up all over the estate and her neighbour Samir has been checking sheds. She's also got her final nursing placement assessment on Thursday, so the timing couldn't be worse. Message her tomorrow to see if there's any news.
Grocery run, then gym. Nothing else today.
Samir mentioned he's learning Portuguese before his trip to Porto at Easter. He's using an app and has a 200 day streak.
Sara's son has his driving test on 10/30 and she's let him borrow her car for lessons. Good luck text the morning of, if I remember.
Nina said Pedro's mum is coming over from Madrid for Christmas and staying three weeks. Nina is quietly dreading it.
Deepa loves true crime podcasts and has started collecting vintage typewriters. Birthday is December 1st.
Ayo passed her driving test yesterday! She's already looking at second hand Fiestas.
Petra's daughter Lola starts nursery next Monday, and Petra is back at work the same day. Message her on Monday evening to see how both went.
